description: St Helens BC publishes redacted direct-payment-individual rows under supplier_name='Personal Data' with narrative='REDACT - PERSONAL INFORMATION'. Match BOTH the supplier name and the REDACT prefix on the narrative for safety. Without this rule the supplier-bucket 'Personal Data' will appear as the council's largest by row-count and skew HHI / duplicate / split-payment forensics.

rules.reason: Direct payment to service-user, foster carer, SGO recipient. Sample Feb 2026 file shows several rows of supplier='Personal Data' with narrative='REDACT - PERSONAL INFORMATION'. Lawfully unnamed under Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR. Pattern uppercased 11 Jun 2026 (classifier matches uppercased fields; the mixed-case 'Personal Data' alternative was dead: 74 rows / GBP 1.0m sat in procurement_paid).
